_README: EXAMPLE project context (fictional 'Acme ERP' program). Single source of truth for project specifics — all training-suite skills read the project's copy of this file. Copy this file per engagement, swap the values, and point the skills at the copy; edit it once and every skill picks up the change. Fields marked PLACEHOLDER are best-guess or unconfirmed — the practitioner must confirm/replace them; nothing here should be treated as fact until confirmed.

platform.modules: PLACEHOLDER — confirm the in-scope platform modules. Example placeholders: Finance/GL, Procurement, Inventory, Point of Sale, Planning. Replace with the confirmed list.

locations: PLACEHOLDER — e.g. specific sites/regions or 'All locations'

audiences.name: Frontline staff (store / floor / counter)
audiences.channel_constraints: On-floor or on-shift, little desk time, shared/mobile devices, high turnover

_audiences_note: These are example archetypes — NOT confirmed roles. Replace with the real role inventory (ideally reconcile against the CIA 'roles_impacted' fields, which are canonical).
_modalities_note: in-app guidance = digital adoption overlay (e.g. WalkMe or the vendor's guided-learning tool). Default modality mix is tuned by workforce type: frontline/high-turnover → in-app guidance, job aids, microlearning; office/professional → deeper ILT/VILT mix.

adoption_metrics: PLACEHOLDER — e.g. transaction accuracy, system-vs-workaround usage, help-desk ticket volume, time-to-competency

tone: Practical, learner-friendly, in-the-flow-of-work. Short sentences. Plain language, not system jargon. American English (color, organize, behavior).

brand._note: PLACEHOLDER colors (Capgemini-adjacent). Swap for the agreed program palette if one exists.
